name: YMCA Camp Lincoln Counselors in Training (CIT)
description_short: A leadership program for teens at YMCA Camp Lincoln. Junior CIT is a paid 4-week session for 14-year-olds. Senior CIT is a free 8-week program for 15-year-olds, by application only. CITs work in cabins and lead activities alongside experienced staff.

Junior CIT participants cannot come back to camp as traditional or specialty campers later.
